## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Quickstart — Docs Page

**Figma frame:** _Quickstart — Docs Page_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-19 (cards, badges, and tags), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

Step-by-step getting started guide page layout with hero image and code snippets.

### What to design (in Figma)

- Quickstart title, subtitle, hero image, and sequential getting-started steps.
- Code snippet anatomy, copy affordance states, and explanatory text treatment.
- Reading layout and mobile behavior for long code blocks.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile quickstart documentation frames.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Step order is clear and supports a first-time setup flow
- [ ] Code snippets remain legible and usable at all target widths
- [ ] Copy and code-block states are documented
- [ ] Uses UI-17 dark-mode tokens and UI-20 responsive rules
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
